recursive_model.referent: how a generic bounded outside observer can model DeepRMM from its public trajectory

authority_boundaries.input: opponent-observable game state, public history, and immutable candidate actions only
authority_boundaries.output: relative public expectedness evidence for the selector
authority_boundaries.admissibility: directional evidence is restricted to candidates already inside a narrow economic-regret set
authority_boundaries.excluded: candidate generation, planner alteration, hidden-identity claims, exact message reconstruction, legality overrides, arithmetic overrides, terminal overrides, dominant-action overrides, and catastrophic-loss overrides

online_evaluation.epoch_boundary: first accepted DeepRMM v97 move carrying a forecast and selection receipt from this activation
online_evaluation.registry: append-only prospective forecast and selection registry
online_evaluation.failure_action: omit self-mirror evidence and preserve the existing guarded decision path
